beats: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat and arms beside you.
Press through heels and raise your hips slightly with ribs down.
Continue raising the hips while keeping the feet and shoulders planted.
Finish with shoulders, hips and knees aligned; squeeze the glutes.
Lower the hips under control without changing foot position.
Continue lowering toward the mat before the next repetition.
